# positions 0-6 dots, then unit A 7-35, then unit B 37-65, unit C 67-95, then 96-102 dots.
# Each unit: ((.((.((....)).((...))...))))
# Build seq: pair positions get complementary. Use GC at closing pairs, A at unpaired.
# Pairs list:
pairs=[(7,35),(8,34),(10,33),(11,32),(13,20),(14,19),(22,28),(23,27),(37,65),(38,64),(40,63),(41,62),(43,50),(44,49),(52,58),(53,57),(67,95),(68,94),(70,93),(71,92),(73,80),(74,79),(82,88),(83,87)]
seq=['A']*103
import itertools
# assign GC at closing pairs (outermost of each stem region) and CG alternating
# Let's just assign: outer helix GC/CG alternating, inner helices GC, and loops A-rich.
# For each pair, decide base
def assign(pairs):
    s=['A']*103
    # triloops and tetraloops: place caps
    # hairpin1 loop 15-18 (tetraloop) closing 14-19 -> GAAA
    # hairpin2 loop 24-26 (triloop) closing 23-27 -> 
    # Use GAAA tetraloop, GAA triloop
    caps={(14,19):'GAAA',(44,49):'GAAA',(74,79):'GAAA', (23,27):'GAA',(53,57):'GAA',(83,87):'GAA'}
    for (cl,cr),motif in caps.items():
        for k,pos in enumerate(range(cl+1,cr)):
            s[pos]=motif[k]
    # Now pairs: closing pair C-G per advice (close with C-G). 
    # For each stem, set closing pair = C-G (left C, right G). Interior stack pairs = G-C.
    closing={(14,19),(23,27),(44,49),(53,57),(74,79),(83,87)}
    for (i,j) in pairs:
        if (i,j) in closing or (j,i) in closing:
            s[i]='C'; s[j]='G'
        else:
            s[i]='G'; s[j]='C'
    return ''.join(s)
seq=assign(pairs)
print(seq)
print(len(seq))
"
